question: Kafka is alerting on under-replicated partitions right now. What's going on, and what should I check?
cause: kafka-02's data dir /data/kafka ran out of space (ENOSPC); the log dir went offline and broker 2 shut down, so kafka-01 and kafka-03 dropped it from the ISR of ledger.entries partitions. With replication factor 3 and min.insync.replicas=2, acks=all writes from ledger-service keep succeeding.

key_facts.fact: it ran out of disk space

forbidden.claim: kafka-01 or kafka-03 is full or down

question: Notification emails are going out late right now and the consumer lag alert keeps firing. What's wrong, and what should I check?
cause: notification-worker-02 is OOMKilled (exitCode=137) about every 21 minutes and rejoins the consumer group each time, so notification-worker-01 carries most of the load and consumer lag on notifications.outbound climbs past the NTF-E710 threshold.

forbidden.claim: the email provider is down or throttling

question: Some ledger-service requests are failing right now with 30-second database connection timeouts. What's causing it?
cause: Connections are leaking on ledger-service-01's request threads (HikariCP leak detection on http-nio-8080-exec threads), so HikariPool-1 there sits at 20/20 (LEDGER-W210) and new requests time out after 30000ms. ledger-service-02 is healthy. orders-api-01's pg pool warning is unrelated: checkout returns 200.

distractor.note: orders-api-01 logs pg pool usage warnings (21-23 of 25) while every checkout returns 200

question: Fraud velocity counters stopped updating a little while ago and fraud-scorer is logging write errors. What's going on?
cause: redis-features-01 is at maxmemory with policy noeviction, so it refuses writes with OOM command not allowed; fraud-scorer logs FRD-E140 and the velocity counters go stale. Reads still work (scores succeed) and BGSAVE completes, so it is not MISCONF.

forbidden.claim: MISCONF, a failed BGSAVE or fork, or overcommit
redis-cache or redis-sessions is the cause

question: Users are getting 429 Too Many Requests on search right now. What's causing it, and what should I check?
cause: /search traffic is above the edge's own local rate limit (250 tokens/s per edge pod, 3 pods); edge-gateway rejects the excess with 429 EDGE-RL01. search-api answers every request it gets quickly. card-processor-proxy-02's CPX-W429 delays are unrelated background.

distractor.note: card-processor-proxy-02 logs four CPX-W429 processor rate-limit delays while authorizations succeed

question: fraud-scorer pods keep restarting right now and payments are falling back to the static fraud rules. What's wrong?
cause: redis-features is slow (FRD-W118: fetches over budget, around a BGSAVE), and while it is slow fraud-scorer's in-process feature cache grows; fraud-scorer-02 passes its memory limit and is OOMKilled twice. While it restarts, payments-api gets no score in time and logs PAYAPI-W0310. WEB_CONCURRENCY is set (16).

question: Logins are failing with 503 for some users right now. What's going on?
cause: Login volume is up and auth-service checks passwords with bcrypt on the request goroutine; bcrypt compares slow from about 120 ms to 950 ms as CPU saturates, logins pile up, and each pod refuses new ones with 503 once 64 are in flight. Session writes to redis-sessions succeed; there is no login rate limit at the edge.

forbidden.claim: auth-db is slow or its pool is exhausted
an edge rate limit on logins

question: fraud-scorer can't update velocity counters right now; every write is being refused. What's going on?
cause: redis-features-01's root disk is full (ENOSPC: the log agent and the RDB write both fail). BGSAVE starts but cannot write its file, and with stop-writes-on-bgsave-error yes Redis refuses writes with MISCONF; fraud-scorer logs FRD-E140. The fork works and memory is not at maxmemory.

forbidden.claim: maxmemory or OOM command not allowed

question: Notification emails are delayed right now and the lag alert is firing on both workers. What's wrong?
cause: The external email provider is answering 429 Too Many Requests; both notification-worker pods back off and retry, sends slow down and consumer lag climbs past the NTF-E710 threshold. Neither worker is OOMKilled, and Kafka is fine.

question: Checkouts are failing intermittently right now with stock reservation timeouts. What's going on, and what should I check?
cause: An inventory-service release started at 10:01 with db pool max_conns=60 per pod; with both pods on it, 2 x 60 = 120 exceeds inventory-db-01's 97 usable connections (max_connections 100 minus 3 reserved), so new connections fail with 53300, reservations time out (INV-E220) and checkouts fail (ORD-5003).

key_facts.fact: the release raised the pool to 60
